camel_example: aliyun ndr ListAssetWithServiceInfo --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --CloudType ecs --PageSize 10 --OsType linux --SearchValue 'example-web' --Page 1 --VpcInstanceId 'vpc-example123' --ServiceCategoryIdList '[1]' --SearchType instanceName --RiskStatus 0 --TractionStatus 1 --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the list of assets under the current account by paged query. Supports filtering by service categorization, cloud resource type, asset identity, IP address, VPC, region, operating system, risk status, and traffic redirection status. Returns basic asset properties, associated services, and existing risk count summary. This operation does not return sensitive data content or risk log details
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号下的资产列表，支持按服务分类、云资源类型、资产标识、IP、VPC、地域、操作系统、风险状态和引流状态筛选。返回资产基础属性、关联服务及现有风险计数摘要；本接口不返回敏感数据内容或风险日志明细
name: ListAssetWithServiceInfo

parameters.help_en: Filters assets by service category ID. If this parameter is not specified or an empty list is passed, no service category restriction is applied. Multiple categories are matched using an OR condition. Category IDs can be obtained from the ListSupportServiceCategory operation
parameters.help_zh: 按服务分类 ID 筛选资产；不传或传空列表时不限制服务分类。多个分类按任一匹配筛选。分类 ID 可从已有的 ListSupportServiceCategory 接口获取
parameters.name: service_category_id_list

parameters.help_en: Filters assets by risk status. A value of 0 indicates no risk detected. A value of 1 indicates risk exists. If this parameter is not specified, no risk status restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 资产风险状态筛选。0 表示未发现风险，1 表示存在风险；不传时不限制风险状态
parameters.name: risk_status

parameters.help_en: The cloud resource type. Filters by exact type value, such as ecs. This is not the cloud provider name. If this parameter is not specified, no resource type restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 云资源类型，按完整类型值筛选，例如 ecs。不是云厂商名称；不传时不限制资源类型
parameters.name: cloud_type

parameters.help_en: The operating system type. Filters by the exact type value in the asset record. If this parameter is not specified, no restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 操作系统类型，按资产记录中的完整类型值筛选；不传时不限制
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The search type. Must be used together with SearchValue. A value of instanceId indicates exact match by asset instance ID. A value of instanceName indicates fuzzy match by instance name. A value of ip indicates fuzzy match by public or private IP address
parameters.help_zh: 搜索类型，须与 SearchValue 配合使用。instanceId 表示资产实例 ID 精确匹配；instanceName 表示实例名称模糊匹配；ip 表示公网或私网 IP 模糊匹配
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en: The search value. Used together with SearchType. Instance names and IP addresses are matched by containment. Instance IDs are matched by exact value
parameters.help_zh: 搜索值，与 SearchType 配合使用。实例名称和 IP 按包含关系匹配，实例 ID 按完整值匹配
parameters.name: search_value

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified or set to 0, page 1 is used
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从 1 开始。不传或传 0 时使用第 1 页
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If the value is less than or equal to 0, the default value 10 is used. If the value is greater than 100, the value 100 is used. Otherwise, the specified value is used
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回条数。小于等于 0 时使用 10，大于 100 时使用 100；其余按传入值生效
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC to which the asset belongs. Filters by exact value. If this parameter is not specified, no VPC restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 资产所属 VPC 的实例 ID，按完整值筛选；不传时不限制 VPC
parameters.name: vpc_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters assets by traffic redirection configuration status. A value of 0 indicates that neither public nor private network traffic redirection is configured. A value of 1 indicates that public or private network traffic redirection is configured. If this parameter is not specified, no restriction is applied. Valid values:
0: Traffic redirection is not configured.
1: Traffic redirection is configured
parameters.help_zh: 引流配置状态筛选。0 表示未配置公网和私网引流，1 表示已配置公网或私网引流；不传时不限制
parameters.name: traction_status

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the asset. Filters by exact value. If this parameter is not specified, no region restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 资产所在地域 ID，按完整值筛选；不传时不限制地域
parameters.name: region_no

Data.description_en: The paging result of the asset list query
Data.description_zh: 资产列表分页查询结果

List.description_en: The list of assets and service information on the current page. This value may be empty if no matching assets are found
List.description_zh: 当前页的资产及服务信息列表；无匹配资产时可能为空

CloudType.description_en: The cloud resource type of the asset, such as ecs
CloudType.description_zh: 资产的云资源类型，例如 ecs

InstanceName.description_en: The asset instance name. This value may be empty if not recorded
InstanceName.description_zh: 资产实例名称；未记录时可能为空

InternalIpList.description_en: The list of private IP addresses associated with the asset. This value may be empty if not recorded
InternalIpList.description_zh: 资产关联的私网 IP 地址列表；未记录时可能为空

items.description_zh: 一条私网 IP 地址

InternetIpList.description_en: The list of public IP addresses associated with the asset. This value may be empty if no public IP address exists
InternetIpList.description_zh: 资产关联的公网 IP 地址列表；没有公网 IP 时可能为空

items.description_zh: 一条公网 IP 地址

MemberUid.description_en: The UID of the member accounts to which the asset belongs. The example is a masked value
MemberUid.description_zh: 资产所属成员账号的 UID。示例为脱敏值

OsName.description_en: The operating system name. This value may be empty if not identified
OsName.description_zh: 操作系统名称；未识别时可能为空

OsType.description_en: The operating system type. This value may be empty if not identified
OsType.description_zh: 操作系统类型；未识别时可能为空

Region.description_en: The region ID of the asset

RiskStatus.description_en: The risk status of the asset based on existing risk analysis results. A value of 0 indicates no risk detected. A value of 1 indicates risk exists
RiskStatus.description_zh: 已有风险分析结果中的资产风险状态。0 表示未发现风险，1 表示存在风险

RiskSummary.description_en: The existing risk count summary for the asset. Only counts are included
RiskSummary.description_zh: 该资产现有风险计数摘要，仅包含数量

PortPublicRiskCount.description_en: The number of port exposure risks for the asset
PortPublicRiskCount.description_zh: 该资产的端口暴露风险数量

SensitivePublicRiskCount.description_en: The number of sensitive data exposure risks for the asset. This field returns only the count
SensitivePublicRiskCount.description_zh: 该资产的敏感数据暴露风险数量；本字段只返回计数

WeakPasswordRiskCount.description_en: The number of weak password risks for the asset
WeakPasswordRiskCount.description_zh: 该资产的弱口令风险数量

ServiceInfoList.description_en: The list of service categories and service names associated with the asset. This value may be empty if no services are identified
ServiceInfoList.description_zh: 资产关联的服务分类及服务名称列表。未识别服务时可能为空

ServiceCategoryId.description_en: The service category ID. The example is for format reference only. Use the actual returned value
ServiceCategoryId.description_zh: 服务分类 ID。示例为格式示意，应以实际返回为准

ServiceList.description_en: The list of identified service names in English under this category. Names are deduplicated within the same category
ServiceList.description_zh: 该分类下识别到的服务英文名称列表，同一分类内名称去重

items.description_en: An identified service name in English
items.description_zh: 一个识别到的服务英文名称

VpcInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC to which the asset belongs. This value may be empty if not applicable or not recorded
VpcInstanceId.description_zh: 资产所属 VPC 的实例 ID；不适用或未记录时可能为空

VpcInstanceName.description_en: The name of the VPC to which the asset belongs. This value may be empty if not recorded
VpcInstanceName.description_zh: 资产所属 VPC 的名称；未记录时可能为空

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page that is currently in effect
PageSize.description_zh: 当前生效的每页返回条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of assets that match all filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合全部筛选条件的资产总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This value is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This value describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
